help.title: Help & Support
help.faqPairingQuestion: How do I pair with my partner?
help.faqPairingAnswer: Tap the 'Pair' button on your profile screen and share the displayed code with your partner. When your partner enters the code from the same screen, pairing is complete.
help.faqProposalQuestion: How do I propose a date plan?
help.faqProposalAnswer: Swipe on your favorite plans from the date candidates on the home screen. When your partner also favorites the same plan, it becomes a 'match'.
help.faqNotificationAnswer: Make sure notifications are ON in Profile > Settings > Notification Settings. Also check that notifications are allowed in your device settings.
help.faqDeleteQuestion: I want to delete my account
help.faqDeleteAnswer: Go to Profile > Settings > Privacy and tap 'Request Account & Data Deletion'. Our support team will assist you.
help.faqPremiumAnswer: With a Premium subscription, you can enjoy ad-free experience, unlimited date proposals, and more features. Check the banner on your profile screen for details.
